**In one line**: The US FTC reportedly targeted Anthropic over AI bias while taking a softer line on Grok — despite Musk's admitted interventions — prompting fairness concerns.

### Key points
- According to Tech Times, the FTC has reportedly singled out Anthropic for scrutiny over AI model bias.
- By contrast, xAI's Grok — where Elon Musk has openly acknowledged intervening — is said to have faced a lighter regulatory touch.
- The report frames this as a regulatory-fairness issue, questioning the criteria used to decide which firms are targeted.

### Why it matters
If AI bias enforcement is applied without consistent standards, it risks becoming a proxy for political-bias disputes. The regulatory direction could shape how AI companies handle model training and alignment going forward, making it a closely watched issue across the industry.
